The URL does not prefill a title or description; you will need to enter them on the issue page.

Warning: this destination uses unencrypted HTTP. Data sent between this device and %1$s is not protected by TLS and may be read or modified by network observers. This includes issue URL values and report content pasted after the page opens. Continue only on a trusted network.
The report was copied to the clipboard. Paste it into the issue form before submitting.

Copy the report, then paste it before submitting.
